basis: Diffuse cutaneous venous malformations; limb bone hypoplasia occurs in 80-99%, with cortical/trabecular abnormalities and muscle dysfunction in 30-79%.
Intellectual disability in 4/4 and developmental delay in 2/2 define neurodevelopmental involvement; hirsutism and broad halluces alone do not establish organ damage.
Defined neonatal epilepsy syndrome; normal developmental progress is expected.
Malignant neoplasm originating in chest wall bones; thoracic location does not establish lung involvement.
Microcephaly and chorioretinopathy define the syndrome; intellectual disability occurs in 7/7. Genetic retinal disease does not establish an immune mechanism.
Defined umbrella of hereditary nervous system disorders; no other organ is consistently damaged across its subtypes.
Benign neoplasms of male reproductive organs have no applicable axis; endocrine dysfunction is not characteristic across this group.
Benign epithelial neoplasm arising in skin.
Limb absence, ectodermal dysplasia and lacrimal drainage malformations define the syndrome. Intellectual disability is reported without a reliable frequency.
D2HGDH-related organic acid metabolic disorder; developmental delay and seizures each occur in 2/2 annotated patients. Cardiomyopathy is not established as common in type 1.
Autism spectrum neurodevelopmental disorder with developmental and social impairment.
Alkaline phosphatase deficiency impairs skeletal mineralization; premature tooth loss and dental attachment defects affect roughly 30-50% of mild/adult presentations.
Umbrella disorder of calcium metabolism; skeletal, renal and soft-tissue damage varies by subtype and is not established across most patients.
Disease of cutaneous sweat glands; these are exocrine skin appendages.
PAX8-related thyroid dysgenesis causes congenital thyroid hormone deficiency. Lasting neurologic or skeletal damage is not established as common.
Microspherophakia and metaphyseal bone dysplasia with micromelic dwarfism define the syndrome.
Infectious inflammation directly affects the cornea.
Skeletal dysplasia; pulmonary hypoplasia/respiratory insufficiency, cleft palate and hearing abnormalities each affect 30-79%. Nail hypoplasia omitted by cap; proptosis alone is non-damaging.
Defined by sudden sustained loss of kidney function; electrolyte changes are consequences of renal failure.
Urinary tract obstruction directly causes kidney damage and impaired renal function.
Hepatic glycogen/fat storage defines GSD I; renal tubular/glomerular dysfunction affects >30% over time. Immune defects mainly concern Ib; lasting CNS injury is not typical across the group.
Self-limited infantile seizure syndrome; gastroenteritis is an associated acute illness, without established direct intestinal damage by the seizure disorder.
Dissociative identity disorder is a purely psychiatric condition without established damage to an organ axis.
Premature fusion of multiple cranial sutures defines a skull bone disorder; intracranial pressure risk alone does not establish neurologic damage.
Inflammatory immune-mediated CNS demyelinating disease; ocular symptoms are occasional and do not establish common independent eye damage.
